title.zh: 【渣打银行在香港推出代币化存款服务】
title.en: Standard Chartered launches tokenized deposit service in Hong Kong

current_state.zh:
渣打银行宣布在香港推出面向企业客户的代币化存款解决方案，香港成为其全球网络中首个推出该方案的市场，后续计划扩展至更多市场。该方案基于渣打自有区块链基础设施，在香港金管局分布式账本技术监管孵化器支持下开发，依托 EnsembleTX，代币化存款可在参与银行之间实时转账，并以包括批发型央行数字货币在内的央行货币进行 7×24 小时银行间结算。

该方案面向企业客户的集团内部流动性管理及数字化财资和投资流程，使参与银行之间的代币化存款转账能够以央行货币进行全天候结算。

据 BlockBeats 11 月 2 日援引 Coindesk 报道，早期合作伙伴包括华夏基金（China AMC）、Fireblocks 和 HashKey。目前香港是渣打唯一推出该服务的市场。
current_state.en:
Standard Chartered announced the launch of a tokenized deposit solution for corporate clients in Hong Kong, making the city the first market in its global network to offer the service, with plans to extend it to more markets. Built on the bank's own blockchain infrastructure and developed with support from the HKMA's distributed ledger technology regulatory incubator, the solution relies on EnsembleTX to let tokenized deposits move between participating banks in real time, with interbank settlement in central bank money — including wholesale CBDC — on a 24/7 basis.

The service is aimed at corporate clients' intra-group liquidity management and digital treasury and investment workflows, allowing tokenized deposit transfers among participating banks to be settled in central bank money around the clock.

BlockBeats reported on November 2, citing CoinDesk, that early partners include China AMC, Fireblocks and HashKey. Hong Kong is currently the only market where the bank offers the service.

updates.background_zh: 该方案属于香港金管局 “Ensemble 项目” 的范畴。金管局已启动该项目的试点阶段 EnsembleTX，用于测试使用代币化存款和数字资产进行的真实价值交易，初期重点是让市场参与者将代币化存款用于代币化货币市场基金交易，并实时管理流动性与财资需求；EnsembleTX 将在 2026 年全年运作。批发型央行数字货币是主要面向银行及其他合格金融机构、用于银行间和金融市场结算的央行数字货币，与面向公众的零售型 CBDC 不同。
updates.background_en: The solution sits within the Hong Kong Monetary Authority's Project Ensemble work. The HKMA has launched the pilot phase of the project, called EnsembleTX, to test real-value transactions using tokenized deposits and digital assets, with an initial focus on using tokenized deposits in tokenized money market fund transactions and for real-time liquidity and treasury management; EnsembleTX is set to operate throughout 2026. A wholesale CBDC is a central bank digital currency designed primarily for banks and other eligible financial institutions for interbank and financial-market settlement, as distinct from retail CBDC aimed at the general public.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该服务在香港为银行负债类结算增加了新的通道，与现有稳定币及传统清算渠道并行，影响主要集中在受监管的企业财资与结算基础设施，而非可交易的加密资产本身；Fireblocks、HashKey 等被点名的合作方指向托管与数字资产基础设施服务商，是与加密市场关联最直接的一环。
updates.market_impact_en: The launch adds a bank-liability settlement rail in Hong Kong alongside existing stablecoin and traditional clearing channels, with exposure concentrated in regulated enterprise treasury and settlement infrastructure rather than in traded crypto assets; named partners such as Fireblocks and HashKey point to custody and digital-asset infrastructure providers as the closest links to crypto markets.
